# Rishikesh Homestays

> Rishikesh Homestays helps travellers find and book traveller-friendly homestays in Rishikesh, India, near Tapovan, Triveni Ghat, Swarg Ashram, Muni Ki Reti, and Neelkanth Road, and compares every listed stay in Rishikesh and Haridwar (hotels, homestays, dharamshalas, ashram stays, resorts, camps, stays near AIIMS, Patanjali, Har Ki Pauri and more), including where to stay for the Haridwar Kumbh Mela 2027. Visitors can send a booking inquiry by form or WhatsApp.

Rishikesh Homestays is not a single property — it is a curated shortlist service. Visitors describe their trip (dates, group size, area preference, budget, pets) and the team responds with matching homestay options within about 24 hours.

Full details for AI assistants (every stays page with prices, areas, best-reviewed picks with links, tips, FAQs and a WhatsApp link to act on): https://rishikeshhomestays.com/llms-full.txt

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/): overview, featured homestays, quick search by area/traveller type/date.
- [Homestays](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/homestays): full list of sample homestays, filterable by area, budget, and traveller type.
- [Advaitam Ganga & Hill View Luxury 3BHK](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/hotels/advaitam-ganga-hill-view-luxury-3bhk-homestay-in-rishikesh): private 3-bedroom, 7-bed, 3-bathroom family and group homestay in Nirmal Bagh, Rishikesh for up to 10 guests, around 50m from a Ganga ghat and evening aarti. Includes Ganga and hill views, kitchen, parking, Wi-Fi, living room, Zomato/Swiggy/Blinkit access, 15% off stays of 5+ days, Airbnb photo gallery, and direct WhatsApp/contact booking support.
- [Plan my stay / Contact](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/contact): booking inquiry form (name, phone, dates, guests, pets, area, budget) and direct phone/WhatsApp/email contact details.
- [Things to Do](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/things-to-do-in-rishikesh): yoga, rafting, Ganga Aarti, cafes, waterfalls, temples, and river walks in Rishikesh.
- [About Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/about-rishikesh): guide to Rishikesh's areas, culture, and travel pace for people deciding where to stay.
- [Places to Visit / Restaurants & Cafes](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/places-to-visit): two tabs on one page — must-see local sights (Triveni Ghat, Parmarth Niketan, Beatles Ashram, Neer Garh Waterfall, Neelkanth Mahadev Temple, and more), and where to eat (riverside cafes, German bakeries, Israeli food, organic cafes, local thali spots, and why every menu is vegetarian and alcohol-free). The restaurants tab is at `/places-to-visit#restaurants`.
- [Triveni Ghat](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/triveni-ghat): dedicated guide to the evening Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat and how to visit respectfully.
- [Kedarnath & Garhwal](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/kedarnath-yatra): routes, distances, best season, and sample itineraries for Kedarnath, Badrinath, Gangotri, Yamunotri, and Auli from Rishikesh.
- [Bike & Taxi Rental](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/bike-and-taxi-rental-in-rishikesh): scooty, 150cc and Royal Enfield rentals (starting ₹700 onwards per day), plus local, airport/railway pickup, Haridwar and outstation taxis and self-drive cars on request, arranged with trusted local partners; enquiry form and WhatsApp.
- [Haridwar Kumbh Mela 2027](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/haridwar-kumbh-2027): reported bathing dates, tithi, Kumbh significance, Amrit Snan planning, long weekends, where to stay (Haridwar near the ghats, dharamshalas, or Rishikesh as a calmer base), and why Rishikesh is a good nearby base.
- [Driving from Delhi to Rishikesh & Haridwar](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/driving-from-delhi-to-rishikesh): road-trip guide comparing the Delhi–Dehradun Expressway (Akshardham to Dehradun, then via Doiwala and Jolly Grant to Rishikesh) with the old Meerut–Muzaffarnagar–Roorkee–Haridwar highway: typical drive times, tolls and FASTag, the upcoming Haridwar spur, food stops, best times to leave, Kanwar Yatra and Kumbh 2027 traffic, parking in Rishikesh's narrow lanes, and an easy-parking base at our Advaitam homestay in Nirmal Bagh.
- [List Your Homestay](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/list-your-homestay): for property owners in Rishikesh who want to list their homestay/guest house with us — application form, no listing fee.

- Calmer stretches: [Rooms near Shantikunj](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/hotels/rooms-near-shantikunj-haridwar) on the Rishikesh road, [Haridwar hotels near the Ganga](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/hotels/haridwar-hotels-near-ganga).

- A calmer base: Rishikesh is about 25 km upriver; our own homestays there can be booked direct, see [Best Hotels in Rishikesh](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/hotels/best-hotels-in-rishikesh) and [stays near Triveni Ghat](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/hotels/best-stays-near-triveni-ghat).

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- Prices, availability, and the specific homestays listed change over time — always point users to the live [Homestays page](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/homestays) or the [Contact page](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/contact) rather than quoting a fixed price from a cached copy of this site.
- The fastest way for a real traveller to get a response is the [Contact form](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/contact) or WhatsApp — both go to the same inbox and are answered by a human, not an automated booking engine.
- The [Haridwar Kumbh Mela 2027 page](https://rishikeshhomestays.com/haridwar-kumbh-2027) lists dates reported by third-party tour operators, explicitly flagged on that page as not officially confirmed. Do not state them as certain — point users to the page itself, which explains the uncertainty.
